products.name: Star Gold Gr
products.shortDescription: Biological granule developed from seaweed and plant extracts for optimal crop nutrition and yield enhancement.
products.description: Star Gold Gr is a premium biological granule developed from seaweed and plant extracts based on advanced biological technology. It contains humic acids, amino acids, enzymes and plant growth stimulants required for optimal nutrition of the crop. This scientifically formulated product enhances root development, nutrient absorption and overall plant vitality.
benefits: Seedlings settle quickly due to vigorous growth of crop roots.
Improves absorption of main and micronutrients from the soil by the roots and their distribution throughout the plant, increasing efficiency of given nutrients.
Increases photosynthetic activity by increasing the production of chlorophyll in the leaves.
Reduces the total duration of the crop and reduces the cost of production.
Increases crop yield, commodity quality and soil fertility.
Crops develop immunity and avoid crop damage due to climate change.
Significantly increases the number of flowers in the crop; less flowering increases overall fruits.

composition.ingredient: Seaweed extract (Ascophyllum nodosum), % by weight, maximum

Humic acid (source: Leonardite) per ent. by weight, minimum

specifications.parameter: Free amino acids %, by weight, minimum
Total amino acids %, by weight, minimum
Total dissolved solids %, by weight, minimum
Total organic carbon %, by weight, minimum

methods: Dosage: 10 kg per acre. Can be mixed with any chemical fertilizer and applied together.
Alternative: Can be used in a different application form as directed by an agronomist.
Apply at the time of basal or top dressing fertilizer application for best results.

products.storage: Granular organic granules can be stored for up to three years from the date of production. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

safety.text: Not toxic at all. Completely safe for humans, animals, and the environment.

safety.text: Formulated with natural biological ingredients. No harmful chemical residues.

safety.title: Child Safety
safety.text: Keep out of reach of children. Store in original packaging.

It contains essential humic acids, amino acids, enzymes and plant growth promoters required for optimal crop nutrition. The scientifically formulated granule enhances root development, nutrient absorption, photosynthesis, crop immunity and overall plant growth.
benefits: Promotes vigorous root growth and helps seedlings establish quickly.
Improves absorption of primary and micronutrients from the soil and enhances nutrient-use efficiency throughout the plant.
Increases chlorophyll production and boosts photosynthetic activity.
Reduces crop duration and lowers production costs.
Improves crop yield, produce quality and soil fertility.
Enhances crop resistance against environmental stress and climate changes.
Significantly increases flowering, resulting in improved fruit set and yield.

products.name: Power Booster
products.shortDescription: Liquid bio-stimulant containing seaweed extract, humic acid, fulvic acid, amino acids and vitamins for improved growth, flowering, fruiting and yield.
products.description: Power Booster is a liquid bio-stimulant formulated with Sargassum wightii seaweed extract, humic acid, fulvic acid, amino acids and Vitamin C. It promotes vigorous plant growth, enhances flowering and fruiting, improves crop quality and yield, and helps plants tolerate viral and fungal diseases. Suitable for fruits, vegetables, cereals, pulses and oilseed crops.
benefits: Stimulates overall plant growth.
Induces more flowering and fruit formation.
Prevents shedding of buds, flowers and fruits.
Increases fruit size.
Improves crop quality and marketable yield.
Helps plants fight viral diseases.
Helps plants fight fungal diseases.
Improves nutrient uptake and plant vigor.

composition.ingredient: Sargassum wightii extract, % by weight, minimum
Potassium fulvic humate (Source: Leonardite), % by weight, minimum

specifications.parameter: Total organic carbon %, by weight, minimum

methods: Recommended Crops: Chilli, cotton, soybean, paddy, tomato, cabbage, brinjal, orange, grapes, banana, fruits, vegetables, cereals, pulses and oilseed crops.
Dosage: Mix 2-3 ml of Power Booster per litre of water.
Spray 2-3 times depending on crop condition and growth stage.

products.storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Keep container tightly closed after use.
